Proficient in Salesforce and MS Office products (Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Effective team players who want to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and build working relationships across the organization. As a critical leader within US Consumer Cards (USCC), this role owns end-to-end portfolio performance and channel metrics, is responsible for digital performance in the post-login ecosystem, and leads strategic partner business development. Furthermore, the role serves as the primary product integration point for Risk Management, Finance, and Decision Management/Analytics teams, oversees pricing and yield strategies, directs operating expense management, and champions industry/competitor benchmarking—including owning external relationship management with key market data providers (e.g., Argus) and evaluating competitor quarterly earnings/SEC filings. Key Responsibilities: 1. Portfolio Performance, Metrics & Channel Oversight Portfolio KPI Monitoring: Own and continuously track end-to-end product health metrics, including origination volume, application conversion rates, approval pull-through, average loan size, booked yields, term shifts and repayment trends. Risk Policy Impact Assessment: Analyze and quantify the product and revenue impact of adjustments to credit box parameters, underwriting strategies, and loss forecasting adjustments in partnership with Credit Risk. Channel Performance & Yield Optimization: Monitor multi-channel distribution dynamics (digital direct, branch, aggregators, cross-sell/pre-approved cardmember campaigns) to isolate factors influencing origination KPIs, acquisition costs, and yield. 2. Digital Post-Login Ecosystem Placement & Shelf Parity Oversight Post-Login Funnel & Shelf Parity: Oversee end-to-end PIL digital placement performance across authenticated web and mobile app servicing platforms (e.g., account dashboard, payments hubs, offer centers), ensuring prominent visibility and competitive "shelf space" parity relative to Cards, Line Increases, and other borrowing solutions. Personalization & Decisioning Alignment: Collaborate with Analytics and Marketing Technology to implement dynamic targeting, real-time trigger-based messaging, and contextual banners tailored to eligible cardmembers' financial journeys and liquidity needs. 3. Partner Management & Business Development Strategic Business Development: Collaborates internally on new partnership opportunities, distribution channels, and x-sell initiatives to accelerate PIL originations and market share. Proposals & Business Case Formulation: Front the product conversations on building comprehensive business cases, commercial models, and detailing unit economics. Contract Negotiations & Commercial Terms: Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Sourcing to negotiate partnership agreements, service level agreements (SLAs), and commercial fee structures. 4. Market Intelligence, Competitive Insights & Industry Benchmarks External Market Analytics & Argus Relationship: Serve as the designated business owner for external benchmark data providers, primarily Argus Information & Advisory Services , maximizing utility from syndicated studies and peer data. Pricing & Market Trend Surveillance: Continually survey prevailing market APR structures, promotional pricing models, fee constructs, and loan term options across prime and near-prime installment lending segments. 5. Cross-Functional Integration & Stakeholder Leadership Primary Product Point of Contact (POC): Serve as the central PIL business liaison for: Risk Management: Partner on underwriting optimization, credit tests etc. Finance: Align on Monthly performance, quarterly outlooks, and Multi-Year Operating Plans . Analytics & Decision Management: Collaborate on response model initiatives, customer segmentation, and test-and-learn campaigns. 6. Pricing, Yield Optimization & Expense Management Dynamic Pricing Strategy: Collaborate with analytics to formulate and execute competitive risk-based pricing grids and elasticity frameworks to maximize yield while meeting origination targets. P&L & Expense Oversight: Monitor direct operating expenses, acquisition costs to ensure disciplined budget execution. Qualifications: 10+ years of progressive experience in Consumer Lending, Unsecured Personal Loans, Credit Card Products, or Retail Banking strategy within a major financial institution or leading fintech platform. Demonstrated capability to operate at the C14 (Senior Vice President) level, leading strategic initiatives and managing executive-level stakeholder relationships. Deep understanding of unsecured consumer loan economics, credit risk cycles, revenue drivers (interest income, fees). Proven proficiency in interpreting complex data sets and digital platforms such as PEGA and Adobe. Hands-on experience working with industry benchmark data sources (Argus, TransUnion, Equifax, Mintel), interpreting quarterly banking financial disclosures, and optimizing digital merchandising/placements within authenticated consumer banking platforms. Strong negotiation, interpersonal, and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional peers and senior leadership. Exceptional executive presentation skills—capable of synthesizing complex financial, risk, and commercial data into concise executive decision documents. Proven ability to thrive in a matrixed corporate structure and drive clarity amid shifting market conditions. Drive a high-performance delivery culture that balances velocity with quality, reliability, and security in a regulated financial environment. Remove organizational blockers and dependencies that impede engineering execution, escalating appropriately and decisively. Drive incident management, root cause analysis, and operational stability improvements across the platform. Own technology lifecycle management and technology product management, ensuring all applications and platform components are maintained to the latest standards, current versions, and best practices. Champion the adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities that improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance software quality, and reduce operational overhead. Lead large-scale archive modernization initiatives, including legacy platform retirement, cloud migration, archival data migration, and platform simplification while maintaining business continuity. Establish service level objectives (SLOs), operational metrics, and reliability targets that ensure platform stability, resiliency, and customer satisfaction. Partner with architecture and engineering leaders to ensure solutions are designed for scalability, observability, resiliency, security, and long-term maintainability. Translate strategic intent into actionable engineering plans with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics. Lead structured planning and prioritization processes, balancing new capability delivery, platform modernization, and operational stability. Partner with business stakeholders to align technology delivery with business goals. Establish design principles and platform standards that guide engineering decisions and ensure the Archive platform is a best-in-class product. Communicate technical strategy and delivery roadmaps clearly to both technical and non-technical executive audiences. Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Compliance, and Records Management stakeholders to define the long-term strategy for archival data management, retention, retrieval, governance, and regulatory compliance. Drive technology decisions that balance platform modernization, operational risk reduction, regulatory obligations, scalability, and total cost of ownership. Organizational Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineers. Drive talent development, resource planning, and associate growth. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. Inspire and align the engineering team around a shared modernization vision, maintaining momentum and morale through a complex, multi-phase transformation. Build organizational capabilities that support long-term platform ownership, engineering excellence, and modernization objectives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated domain knowledge in brokerage, financial services operations, back-office processing. Experience building and leading high-performing engineering teams in a fast-paced, regulated environment. Demonstrated strong understanding of the technology ecosystem (logical/physical architecture, processes, tools, types of integrations and data flows, and non-functional requirements such as availability/resiliency, capacity, performance, and observability). Solid understanding of Java, Spring Boot, Kafka for back-end services and API development. Hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3, IAM, Lambda, OpenSearch, and EKS. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices in a regulated financial environment. Solid grasp of software architecture, distributed systems, and real-time data platforms. Deep understanding of archival and retention strategies, information lifecycle management, data governance, and large-scale data migration patterns. Experience designing and operating systems subject to regulatory retention, audit, legal hold, privacy, and recordkeeping requirements. Proven ability to influence enterprise data architecture decisions, including schema design, retention policies, archival patterns, retrieval performance, and integration with distributed systems.
